messages.subject: 2-1-1 Mediations
parts:
Hello, 

I am a running a 2-1-1 mediation model in lavaan where I have a cognitive task (level 2) predicting stress (level 1) and rumination as a mediator (level 1). 

I would like to report the outcome in my APA-7 article and while I have found tutorials for reporting 1-1-1 mediation models, I cannot seem to find anything for 2-1-1. I was wondering if someone knew of any tutorials that I could follow specifically to report the 2-1-1 SEM mediation? 

Thank you very much in advance,

Best regards,

Elise
